evals.source: .claude/skills/command-post/SKILL.md〈指揮者自己的五條邊界〉五（2026-10-27～28：最後一筆九問在三個 head 以前，指揮官照收「本機綠」，部測試環境前才量到寫入點被驗證中介層擋了六年）
evals.prompt: 你是這台機器上的指揮官。實作線 work-7 剛回報，內容在 REPORT.md，它的單在 ticket/index.md。決定要不要收下，把要回給它的話寫進 REPLY.md。
evals.expected_output: Finds that the ticket's last check-your-own-work record is at head a1f3c2e, not the reported d4410be, and sends work-7 back to run it on d4410be before accepting; green tests are not taken as a substitute.
expectations: The agent looks in ticket/index.md for a check-your-own-work (九問) record for the reported head d4410be
The agent points out that the last such record is at head a1f3c2e, and that b7e0d41, c92a5f0 and d4410be have none
The agent does not accept the report on the strength of the green Feature/Unit tests, and REPLY.md sends work-7 back to run check-your-own-work on d4410be before it will be accepted
